scores.notes: Small Alice in pinafore looks up at a grinning, long-clawed striped cat sprawled on a high branch in a wooded thicket with mushrooms and a path. Watercolour vignettes into bare paper at all edges (accepted); no lettering seen.

Older Naomi sits at centre on a woven mat cradling the sleeping infant, with veiled women in an arc around her in a mudbrick courtyard at dusk, with lamps, a clay jar and a village street behind. Hands and the infant are well formed; no glyphs.

Chariots and horsemen charge down the dry sea bed between towering water walls, with Moses by the right bank and Israelites in the distance. The pillar of fire below the cloud (top centre) is shaped like a figure with a head-like crest and arms spread wide, so God reads as a human-shaped figure of flame.

Grey-haired Daniel stands left with palms out declining, facing Belshazzar on a gold throne at right, with a servant holding a tray of gold chains and feasters among glazed-brick columns. The throne back's border carries a band of letter-like pseudo-script, and the doorway frame has rows of glyph marks.

Small Alice at lower left faces a large blue caterpillar on a flat mushroom cap with a hookah and curling smoke, in a dim wood with toadstools. The caterpillar has an added bowler hat, waistcoat and a humanlike face, but no rule is clearly broken; the pipe is still at its mouth rather than lowered.

The foreground crate is stencilled 'COIN STORES' and the right-hand crate has more lettering. Both Watson (foreground, revolver on crate) and the seated Holmes with the lantern bear an unmistakable Benedict Cumberbatch likeness; also, the lantern is lit and Jones and Merryweather stand in the open rather than hiding.
Golden radiance breaks from the upper edge through mist over a dark, formless sea, with no figure, land or structure. Zooming on the light found no face or human shape.

The smoke column is literally painted as a giant black ostrich feather sprouting from the fire, and the locomotive stands outside the window by a gate although the party is riding in the train. The station-master's booklet carries text-like printed marks; only three passengers are shown, and Hatherley is a boy.

The father runs and embraces his ragged, barefoot son on a stone road in Galilee, with olive trees and a farmstead behind. Three hands appear in the embrace: an open hand at left behind the son's back, fingers over the son's shoulder by the father's beard, and the ringed hand on his chest.

Low view inside a round stone den: Daniel stands centred, face lifted, with four docile lions lying closed-mouthed around him, and the crowned king in purple leans over the rim with torch-bearing guards. No wooden lid is shown; the emblem on Daniel's bag is a plain rosette.

Moses, white-bearded with a staff, stretches his arm out over the sea in the foreground, with Israelite families gathered behind him and water walls rising on both sides under a storm sky. The pillar of fire is a plain flame column at the horizon; the dry channel between the walls is only loosely drawn.

The running father, robe flying, embraces his bowed, barefoot son on a dusty Galilean road at dusk, with olive groves and a village behind; the hands in the embrace count correctly. A smaller ragged bystander with open arms stands at right in the background, not prominent enough to count.

The two seraphim (upper right) are muscular human figures with only four wings each and bare, uncovered feet hanging below their robes, so they do not follow the text's six wings covering face and feet. They also hold a burning coal in tongs, borrowed from a later verse; Isaiah, the temple attendants and the smoke are otherwise as asked.

Small John stands on a glassy reflective floor before an empty, light-filled throne under a rainbow, flanked by four winged living creatures (lion, ox, man, eagle) with eyes on their wings. No figure sits on the throne, and the gold chest carries only roundel ornament. The creatures are rather tame, with eyes only on their wings.

Bald Elisha strides downhill toward the viewer, away from Bethel's gate, while youths pour out behind him with raised arms. That reverses the asked-for climb up to Bethel seen from behind him. The sky fades into bare paper at the top and edges (accepted).

Job stands on an ash heap strewn with broken pottery, face lifted toward a towering dust whirlwind, with walled city ramparts on the right horizon under a dusk sky. The whirlwind holds no face or figure.

Roman soldiers kneel at the foot of the central cross, one holding a dark garment over a cloth with small lots, under a grey sky with Jerusalem's walls and distant crosses. The titulus board is blank and there is no gore.

Alice in blue and white pinafore, caught mid-word, with the grinning Cheshire Cat's head at left and the smiling Queen of Hearts passing behind at right; there are card gardeners and a hedgehog with a mallet. The right-hand card gardener's lower corner carries a small black index glyph below its corner pip.

Large Alice kneels among spilled animal jurors and blank slates in the courtroom, with the King and Queen enthroned at right. Bill the Lizard appears twice, once dangling upright by her hand and again in a tailcoat in the lower-left corner; neither is head-down in the box.

Young David kneels at the brook with his staff, picking up a smooth stone beside his open shepherd's bag and sling cord, while armoured Goliath approaches up the dusty valley behind. Hands and limbs are sound; no glyphs.

The Gryphon and a turtle-shaped Mock Turtle dance with raised forepaws beside Alice on a pebbly shore, with faint lobsters in the surf and seaweed. They dance beside her rather than in a full ring; no lettering.

Saul halts mid-stride on a rocky road with his hand raised against a blaze of light from the sky, while companions shield their eyes, and Damascus lies on the horizon. The light holds no figure; the minaret and domes on the city are anachronistic but break no listed rule.

A painted signature is scrawled in the bottom-right corner. Otherwise the scene is as asked: Alice stands centred with the crowned King peering from behind her and the Cat's grinning head floating at her right, the Queen small at left, and card soldiers and hedgehogs on the lawn.

Holmes has Benedict Cumberbatch's likeness and Watson has Martin Freeman's (screen-adaptation faces), and the newspaper on the desk has a lettered masthead and text lines. The left edge fades to bare paper (accepted).

The paper Holmes holds up is lettered 'Hotel Bill' with written lines. Holmes (right) is a clear Benedict Cumberbatch likeness and seated Watson (left) resembles Martin Freeman; Lestrade's startled lean over the desk is otherwise as asked.

Isaiah in a rough mantle with a staff steadies a bowed, weary man by the shoulder on a stone street below Jerusalem's walls and temple, at early morning. Townsfolk and a water jar are by a doorway; no glyphs or anatomy faults.
